title: How a small republic outlasted its neighbors
show: Everything Everywhere Daily: History, Science, Geography & More
description: Travel writer Gary Arndt on how Dubrovnik, founded in the 600s, grew into the Republic of Ragusa, a trading city-state that rivaled Venice. The Rector’s Palace was the seat of its government, where the elected rector served a term of one month.

title: Where quarantine began
episode: The History of Quarantine with Lincoln Paine
description: Maritime historian Lincoln Paine on the history of quarantine. In 1377 Ragusa ordered arrivals from plague areas to wait 30 days before entering. The Lazareti, finished in the 1640s, housed travelers and cargo during that wait.
spotify: The EI Podcast The History of Quarantine with Lincoln Paine
apple: The EI Podcast The History of Quarantine with Lincoln Paine

title: Sailing the coast of a vanished country
description: The hosts of a podcast about vanished states sail down the Dalmatian coast to places from the history of the Republic of Ragusa, ending in Dubrovnik and Cavtat. Ragusa’s ships sailed from this harbor, which was closed with a chain at night.
spotify: Countries That Don't Exist Anymore CTDEA on the waves!

title: Reporting from inside the siege
episode: Paul Davies: How war reporter cheated death during bombing siege of Dubrovnik
description: Paul Davies, a reporter for the British news service ITN, recalls getting into Dubrovnik in 1991, after the Yugoslav army surrounded it as Croatia broke away. On December 6 shells fell across the old town, including the Stradun, its main street.
spotify: Reporting History Paul Davies: How war reporter cheated death during bombing siege of Dubrovnik

title: Daily life in Yugoslav Dubrovnik
description: A podcast about the memory of Yugoslavia, the country Croatia belonged to until 1991, walks through what that era left in Dubrovnik. It visits the Red History Museum, which recreates everyday life under socialism in an old factory in Gruž.

title: King’s Landing with a local guide
show: Rome & Empire with Darius Arya Digs
episode: Games of Thrones season 8 / Dubrovnik exploration with Ivan Vuković
description: Archaeologist Darius Arya walks the city walls and Fort Lovrijenac with local guide Ivan Vuković, sorting the real history from the scenes of Game of Thrones. The fort, on a rock outside the walls, played the Red Keep.
